name: Family Hero (Dwarf only)
body:
Your family tells stories of a great heroic ancestor of yours, and you have traced the route of his quests along a long and winding path. The journey was long, but you used the time to study about the history and current affairs of the region.

Benefit: You get a +1 trait bonus to all Knowledge (history), Knowledge (local) and Knowledge (religion) checks.
